invoiceCatalogueDelivery.status: Implemented locally; apply owner migration 099 after 098 and deploy Runtime API, shared worker host and frontend together. No production import, migration or Xero invoice creation performed.
invoiceCatalogueDelivery.catalogue: Read-only Xero Items, Accounts and TaxRates import through existing tenant-scoped connector, quota and backoff. Existing accounting.settings.read scope is sufficient if actually granted. Independent allowlisted shared-worker lane, durable fenced lease, daily refresh and bounded retry retain the last successful local snapshot. Page reads never call Xero. Saving pins catalogue connection/revision and validates item/account/tax defaults server-side. Missing catalogue fails closed.
invoiceCatalogueDelivery.ux: Prepare invoices is in the Linked invoices header with count beside title. Xero-style compact line table, searchable ManagerSelect Items, read-only account/tax defaults, per-invoice dates and PENDING/advisor metadata, subtotal/tax/conditional-fee breakdown and fixed-footer total. Course category/location controls removed; actual Item codes identify the selection. Unknown billing quantity still needs confirmation. Positive source charges preserved; optional zero rows replaced by Add row. Student remains Xero Contact and Sophia advisor remains Sales Representative.
invoiceCatalogueDelivery.arithmetic: Four-decimal catalogue prices and quantities round once to line minor units; effective tax rates calculate per line. Unknown effective rates are not treated as zero. Conditional source-included fees remain deducted before explicitly adding once. Existing source discrepancy notes, evidence/version gates and idempotency remain.
invoiceCatalogueDelivery.verification: 77 browser tests passed including 390/1440 light/dark layout, four-decimal pricing, source preservation and missing catalogue. 31 fresh disposable PostgreSQL integration tests passed including 099/RLS, concurrent lease, cached refresh failure and stale/invalid catalogue rejection. Build and focused Runtime regression results are recorded in implementation-progress.json.
invoiceCatalogueDelivery.rollout: Keep STUDENT_DOCUMENT_WORKFLOW_ENABLED=true on API/shared worker and existing dependent flags and document tenant allowlist. Apply 099 before deploy. Await first successful background catalogue import; no new write scope or CSV export needed. Live granted scopes and actual provider data remain user-verified. Saved historical proposal snapshots remain readable; old write clients must deploy together. This does not issue, send, approve or modify any Xero invoice.

verifiedDocumentWorkflowDelivery.status: Implemented locally after the user's confirmed workflow decisions; owner migration 098 and coordinated deployment/enablement are pending. Earlier phase entries below describe their original delivery boundaries.
verifiedDocumentWorkflowDelivery.rollout: Apply 098_student_verified_document_workflow.sql after 097 before deploying the new Runtime API/shared worker/frontend. Enable STUDENT_DOCUMENT_WORKFLOW_ENABLED=true on both Runtime API and shared worker, retaining STUDENT_DOCUMENT_ANALYSIS_ENABLED=true, STUDENT_OFFER_ANALYSIS_ENABLED=true and STUDENT_DOCUMENT_CHECKLIST_ENABLED=true. API/worker startup checks dependencies and migration 098. No new Xero permission or provider call is needed for proposals.
verifiedDocumentWorkflowDelivery.reviewPolicy: Initial manual approval for all required documents; no 90-100 percent signature threshold or client checkpoint is invented. Review rejection of latest required evidence puts document-stage Pre-sale cases on hold/Documents Requested; historical reviews cannot override newer uploads. Approved replacement evidence clears only document-owned holds, not a manual hold. Requirements and checklist remain visible on hold; rejected latest rows expose typed replacement Upload. Original files/reviews remain intact. A fully accepted signed engagement plus required-document completeness advances to the existing checklist_complete storage key, now labelled Verified Documents. Replacement/expiry reopens verification in early document stages. Other paid/imported stages are not automatically rewound.
verifiedDocumentWorkflowDelivery.invoiceProposals: Prepare invoices is available under Linked invoices only for authorized financial preparers with fresh accepted evidence, Pre-sale/Verified Documents and a current confirmed offer. One immutable Sophia-only batch per confirmed offer revision contains one INV-n proposal per source instalment; Draft and Payment Track PENDING are proposal labels, not Xero ledger entries or amounts receivable. Details mirror the existing Payments and Control structure, without mixing proposals into Xero financial totals. Advisor code/name is snapshot Sales Representative metadata, not a replacement for the student Contact. Course category/location is explicitly batch-confirmed; ELICOS/week, VET/term and Higher Education/semester. Mixed-category course batches need a future per-course extension rather than inferred classifications.
verifiedDocumentWorkflowDelivery.previewAndFees: Review one instalment at a time; missing quantity/rate, immediate due date, advisor/category/location and charged-line account/tax fields must be confirmed. Optional zero-value fees are excluded. UI initially offers Tuition, Enrolment, Materials, Visa Fee and OSHC lines; confirmed source amounts/dates remain preserved. Explicit conditional fee decision is made for every payment; subtract source-included fee before adding an applicable fee once. Integer quantity/minor-unit arithmetic checks each line. Differences from fee-adjusted source totals or source calendar dates need an audited review note. Tax codes are stored as confirmed draft metadata; tax calculation and Xero issuance are not implemented. Open previews pin the original case/offer version and source; refresh cannot silently rebase edits. Conflict blocks resave until close/reload, uncertain responses retain idempotency.
verifiedDocumentWorkflowDelivery.remaining: Client checkpoint/signature policy definition, authorized live extraction accuracy and performance tests, actual Xero invoice issuance with confirmed item/account/tax/tracking mappings and tax calculation, automatic actual-invoice/LoO comparison, multi-category course preparation and draft amendment/versioning UX. No live provider evaluation, production data mutation or test-record cleanup performed.

status: Phases 1-4 code implemented locally; production rollout and controlled live evaluation remain user-operated. User reports 094/095 applied and worker gpt-4.1/key present; credential validity is not live-tested. Apply 096 then 097; phase 3 requires both backends/worker/frontend and offer-analysis enablement, phase 4 Runtime API/shared worker/frontend and checklist enablement. No live AI extraction, deployment or production mutation performed by agent.

phase4Delivery.rules: With STUDENT_DOCUMENT_CHECKLIST_ENABLED=true, signed engagement and document completeness are evidence-driven read-only items. Latest typed document by immutable discovered_at/UUID wins; never fall back to an older passed upload. Every active required binding needs accepted current evidence, and offers need current confirmed financial approval. Unknown/archived/missing types fail closed; empty requirements are not complete. Invoice consistency and Pending Track remain manual; an offer version change reopens consistency. No automatic stage/status or invoice changes.
phase4Delivery.reconciliation: Transactional upload/result/review/retry/case-edit hooks plus an independent local-only shared-worker lane: 20 cases per tenant tick, 15-second round-robin admission, 15-minute cooldown, SKIP LOCKED and shutdown drain. GET stays read-only and suppresses stale acceptance. Expiry uses Brisbane calendar date and works without more AI calls. Review identity context prevents acceptance silently carrying to a renamed student. Historical document confirmation is blocked; old offer results cannot auto-assign the college.
phase4Delivery.auditAndSecurity: Migration 097 adds scoped latest-evidence cursor with forced RLS/composite case FK and no app DELETE; index uses the existing discovered_at column. Case-first job completion lock order matches API mutations. Boolean transitions only generate SophiaAi activity with rule version and scoped evidence references, never raw text. Manual actions retain existing actor/idempotency/version guards. UI reuses manager checklist and document dialog conventions; newer-upload warning disables historical confirmations.
phase4Delivery.rollout: Apply owner 097 after 096, deploy Runtime API/shared worker host/frontend, then set STUDENT_DOCUMENT_CHECKLIST_ENABLED=true on API and worker. Keep both existing analysis flags, worker model/key and tenant allowlist. Configuration/profile reevaluation is eventual, not an exact-time guarantee. No new provider scopes/services. Disable flag without deleting evidence to stop automation.
phase4Delivery.verification: PASS: 119 focused UI tests, 30 fresh PostgreSQL integration tests with actual migration/normal app role, 65 Runtime tests including real-estate regressions, 14 Express worker tests, frontend app/spec TypeScript and production builds. Initial timestamp-index mismatch was corrected to discovered_at before a fresh full SQL rerun. Synthetic inputs only, no live model/performance claims.
phase4Delivery.remaining: Authorized live accuracy, false-pass, latency and cost measurements; invoice creation/comparison with explicit conditional-fee decision; broader configurable validators for future custom required types. Manual workflow stage/status selection remains unchanged.

phase3Delivery.scope: Stable letter_of_offer uploads use strict provider schema v2; v1 stored offers remain readable. Immutable extraction plus proposed relational courses, fees, instalments and payment components are persisted atomically; confirmation appends a reviewed version with one current confirmed offer per case. Both stated and printed payment totals remain unchanged; conditional fees are not applied and literal Immediate terms get no invented date.
phase3Delivery.college: Tenant-filtered active company directory; unique conflict-free normalized exact match may assign only an unassigned case with clear identity/evidence. Partial, duplicate or identifier conflicts require choice. Existing different college needs explicit replacement. Existing College Details contract is reused through a same-company, transaction-locked create/reuse endpoint, preserving review edits on directory refresh.
phase3Delivery.review: Manager-only native dialog, editable multiple courses/fees/payments/components, minor-unit arithmetic, source evidence, mandatory note, optimistic document/case versions and unexplained-total acknowledgement. Rejection preserves evidence and supersedes the result's current offer. Activity records SophiaAi or authenticated actor. Saved typed app-uploads with stored hashes can explicitly start a check without reupload; no arbitrary imported-file backfill.
phase3Delivery.rollout: Apply 096 after 095; deploy Express Business Manager backend, Runtime API, shared worker and frontend. Set STUDENT_OFFER_ANALYSIS_ENABLED=true on Runtime API and worker; retain global analysis flag, approved worker model and server key. No additional service required. Migration and deployment are user-operated.
phase3Delivery.verification: PASS: 149 focused ChromeHeadless tests, 29 real local PostgreSQL integration tests with migration 096 and normal app role, 60 Runtime tests including real-estate regressions, 25 Express backend tests, frontend app/spec TypeScript and Runtime/frontend production builds. Existing frontend bundle/font/CommonJS/primeicons warnings remain. Tests use synthetic/mocked document extraction, not live provider accuracy or performance measurements.
phase3Delivery.remaining: Phase 4 checklist/replacement/expiry reevaluation and authorized live accuracy/cost evaluation. No invoices, conditional-fee choices or automatic status advancement in phase 3.

phase2Delivery.scope: New passport/engagement uploads enqueue atomically by stable requirement key. Dedicated pack-local OpenAI adapter uses strict per-kind Structured Outputs, direct PDF/image input, store:false, bounded output and safe error handling. Worker validates stored content hash through existing Xero admission before extraction; completion appends a SophiaAi activity event. Letter of Offer is delivered separately in phase3Delivery.
phase2Delivery.execution: Existing shared worker has a separate all-day, round-robin, one-in-flight analysis lane with guarded five-second ticks and shutdown drain; invoice/student stages do not await it. Uses the existing explicit document customer allowlist and normal runtime role, with quota/backoff/model/key/table preflight. Optional standalone operator supports explicit tenant IDs and once/continuous modes.
phase2Delivery.review: Local-only metadata status and bounded visible-page polling. Manager review dialog shows evidence and permits corrected name/expiry/signer plus required note and confirm/reject. Review is append-only, actor-scoped idempotent and optimistic-version checked; failed checks retry the same saved file. Advisors receive safe status, not extraction. Expired passports stay invalid after manual confirmation. Conflicting expiry requires explicit user verification. No automatic checklist/status changes.
phase2Delivery.limitations: Activation is opt-in; old imported/untyped files are not automatically analyzed. Current business date is Australia/Brisbane, matching this deployment. Manual confirmation is an audited human judgment, not cryptographic document authentication. No live provider accuracy/cost measurements yet; wider replacement/authoritative document selection remains phase 4.

objective: Validate uploaded engagement letters and passport expiry; extract and review case-specific offer courses, fees and instalments; resolve the college within the authenticated company.

repositoryEvidence.upload: student-operations-case-documents.service.ts finalizes document metadata and case activity after Xero upload. Enqueue analysis atomically at this durable finalization point, including receipt recovery paths.
repositoryEvidence.ai: Existing OpenAIResponsesReasoningProvider uses Responses with server credentials, timeouts and store:false, but is a conversational text/tool stream. Introduce a separate document-extraction provider interface/adapter reusing configuration conventions; do not route private documents through conversation history or grant model tools.
repositoryEvidence.workflow: Migration 093 supplies stable status requirement keys. Associate extractors with stable semantic keys, never editable type names or filenames. Custom document types remain uploadable without implying automatic validation support.
repositoryEvidence.college: Existing bm.colleges routes are company-scoped. College creation requires college_name; sites require city and have separate contact/address fields. Reuse this contract and manager form. Case association uses the tenant-local college directory; creation must make the new college available there before assignment, with recoverable retry if propagation fails.
repositoryEvidence.samples: Local PDFKit extraction found four engagement pages; final history contains Signed, a named signed event and completion with matching document ID. The seven-page offer has almost no extractable text, requiring vision/OCR. Supplied offer screenshots show a 9040 AUD base total, 9065 AUD listed instalment sum and a first 25 AUD transfer fee, plus conditional transfer-fee wording. Preserve the distinction rather than flagging a false mismatch or adding fees twice. The passport image expiry reads 2035-08-06. No sample binaries or personal identifiers copied into the repository; no live extraction API called.

invoiceConditionalFeeDecision.requirement: Preserve the offer's stated base total and original instalment amounts, including any transfer fee already included. Store the 25 AUD international transfer fee separately as conditional; extraction must not decide whether it applies.
invoiceConditionalFeeDecision.futureInvoiceFlow: At invoice creation, require the user to explicitly choose whether the transfer fee applies to that invoice/payment. A student paying from an Australian account may not incur it. Do not infer the choice from nationality, address or student location, and do not default an unresolved choice to inclusion or exclusion.
invoiceConditionalFeeDecision.calculation: Show the base amount, conditional transfer fee and resulting invoice total. If the source instalment already includes the fee, reconcile its component once rather than adding it again. For this sample the first payment is 970 AUD without the fee or 995 AUD with it. Preserve source totals of 9040 AUD and 9065 AUD unchanged as document evidence; the eventual invoice reflects the user's selection.
invoiceConditionalFeeDecision.auditAndConsistency: Persist the fee selection and amount with the future invoice, including actor and timestamp. Invoice/LoO consistency must account for this explicit conditional-fee decision rather than treating a justified 25 AUD difference as an error. Do not create invoices or apply fees during document extraction.
invoiceConditionalFeeDecision.acceptance: Test inclusion, exclusion, unresolved choice and a source amount already including the fee; verify one fee at most per applicable payment and no mutation of extracted source values.

experience: Save case, upload each document independently, then close the modal after durable upload. Start analysis immediately in a background queue; do not wait for all three documents or the overnight discovery window.

Document rows show Checking, Passed, Needs review, Invalid or Check failed. View/download remain available. Retry analysis reuses the stored attachment and never requires another upload or creates an overflow Contact.

Review opens an existing-style manager dialog/drawer with extracted values, source page/evidence, editable corrections and explicit confirm. Failed analysis is distinct from an invalid document. Preserve work after navigation/restart.

Offer review displays college, one or more courses, fee breakdown, instalments, currency and unresolved terms. Save extraction as a proposed case-linked offer immediately; mark confirmed values separately before future financial use.

A unique active normalized exact college-name match within the company may auto-assign when the case is unassigned and identifiers do not conflict. Preserve an existing different college and ask for review. Duplicate exact or partial matches require selection; never auto-select the first candidate.

If no suitable college exists, an authorized user can open the existing college creation form with extracted name/ABN prefilled, provide mandatory information, save and return to offer review. Missing privileges yield an actionable request to an authorized colleague.

Reuse manager controls, toasts, focus behavior and mobile/dark layouts. Poll only while jobs are pending and the case is visible; stop after terminal states. Page reads use local database projections.

validation.common: Validate actual document category and student text identity against the saved case; name variants or disagreement require review. Treat all document text as untrusted evidence, never instructions. Missing/unclear values remain null with reasons; do not fabricate. Source page numbers and concise evidence accompany fields. Model confidence alone cannot authorize a pass.
validation.engagement: Extract history status, student signer, signed timestamp, completion status, document ID and evidence pages; correlate history with the agreement and student. Sent/viewed alone never pass. Inspect signature pages when history is absent or ambiguous. Record signature evidence present, not cryptographic authenticity. Missing or conflicting evidence goes to manual review; verified e-signature-provider validation is a separate future capability.
validation.passport: Extract expiry and sufficient textual identity to compare with the case. Cross-check visible expiry against readable MRZ and check digits where available. Persist expiry as DATE and calculate expired against the company-local current date on reads/workflow checks, including later expiry without another AI call. Invalid date, unreadable content or conflicting readings require review. This check does not establish identity, authenticity, visa eligibility or a six-month-validity rule. Avoid retaining passport number, full MRZ or portrait unless a separately defined feature requires them.
validation.offer: Extract provider name/ABN/CRICOS where stated; courses as a list including code, duration and study dates; itemized fee amounts and stated totals; instalment number, literal due term, optional resolved DATE, itemized amounts and total; currency and conditional fees. Use decimal or integer minor-unit arithmetic. Keep Immediately as a term with unresolved date until confirmed; do not silently substitute upload date. Reconcile like-for-like totals and flag unexplained differences. Preserve conditional fees, discounts, packages and multiple courses without double counting.
validation.replacement: Every result references document version/hash and extraction/rule version. Late jobs cannot overwrite a replacement or reviewer corrections. Keep prior evidence and confirmation history; replacing an authoritative document marks dependent checks for reevaluation.
validation.checklist: Integrate via the existing audited checklist service. Signed engagement can complete only with qualifying evidence/review. Document completeness requires accepted current required documents, not mere file presence. Invoice/LoO consistency waits for an actual invoice comparison; Pending Track remains independent. Record automatic transitions as SophiaAi with reason/date, manual confirmations with authenticated user. Do not advance case status automatically.

proposedSchema.purpose: Tenant/case/document FK, content hash, extractor/version, state, attempts, next attempt, lease, safe error and usage metadata. Unique job identity prevents duplicate processing; durable reclaim after crashes.
Immutable versioned typed extraction JSON, source evidence, rule outcomes, provider/model/schema versions and timestamps. Restricted access and retention; never raw binary/provider response logs.
Result-linked actor, decision, corrections, reason and timestamp; optimistic version checks and audited authoritative result selection.
Case/document/result link, version, proposed/confirmed/superseded state, extracted provider, resolved college ID, currency and stated totals. Explicit current offer; preserve revised offers.
Offer-linked course name/code, start/end dates, duration and ordering; supports package offers.
Offer/course-linked fee category, source label, exact amount, currency and conditional/included treatment.
Offer/course reference, sequence, due term/date, exact total, component breakdown, conditional-fee terms and evidence.

securityAndPerformance: Use existing authenticated tenant and case permissions, forced RLS, composite tenant FKs and idempotent audited writes. Model output cannot supply trusted tenant/college IDs or authorize database writes.

Background worker downloads only authorized stored Xero attachments under existing quota/backoff, checks byte size/type/hash and processes in bounded memory. Xero remains durable storage until S3. Retain storage abstraction so provider migration does not affect results.

Separate analysis concurrency from overnight imports; durable queue, fair tenant admission, limited retries/backoff and dead-letter/manual retry. Enqueue transactionally with upload completion; repair missing jobs safely. Never hold a DB transaction open during Xero/OpenAI calls.

Use Responses PDF/image input and strict Structured Outputs; validate schema and business rules on server. Start with full bounded document input for reliability, then optimize page selection only against measured accuracy. Pin an approved configurable vision model after representative evaluation; do not assume cheapest is adequate.

Deduplicate extraction by tenant/hash/type/schema version; recompute case identity and current-date checks per association. No cross-company cache. Record latency, tokens, cost and review/error rates without document contents in logs.

Use store:false and direct in-memory inputs where feasible; verify configured provider retention separately because this is not a zero-retention guarantee. If provider Files are used, track cleanup. No vector store or conversational persistence needed.

delivery.scope: Schema, provider interface, strict extraction contracts, deterministic validators, durable queue and versioned review contract; fixtures and tenant/concurrency tests.
Upload-triggered background extraction, passport and engagement checks, per-row states, evidence review/correction/retry. Evaluate live model only in explicitly authorized environment.
Offer courses/fees/instalments persistence and review, exact/partial college resolution and existing create-college form integration.
Audited checklist automation, replacement/expiry reevaluation and operational measurements; controlled rollout behind a feature flag.

acceptance: Unsigned/viewed-only, wrong student, expired/unreadable passport, conflicting dates, scanned tables, Immediate due terms, conditional fees and multiple courses have deterministic expected outcomes.
One upload produces one logical analysis; restart/retry leaves one accepted result. Later replacement or manual correction survives stale job completion.
Unique college match, duplicate match, partial selection, no match, creation permissions and concurrent duplicate creation are covered. No cross-company college/result access.
Automatic/manual checklist transitions retain actor provenance and do not claim invoice consistency before comparison.

Measure p50/p95 upload completion, queue wait, extraction duration and case page responsiveness plus cost/document and false-pass rate on sanitized varied fixtures. Re-run existing real-estate protections and manager desktop/mobile light/dark checks.
